meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 多一条真实手机号:能收发短信,并用 AI 语音接听打进来的电话,收发都走 dial 命令行工具。安装过程会复制 Dial 适配器与测试、注册渠道、装依赖并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你想给 Claude 接上 Dial 渠道(真实手机号、短信、AI 语音通话)时接管,由它完成复制适配器、注册渠道、登录 Dial、配对手机号等步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 Dial 渠道加上,给我一个能收短信的手机号
say.note: 会安装适配器并引导你登录 Dial

say.text: 这条 Dial 线路只允许我自己的手机号发消息进来
say.note: 把未知发件人策略设为 strict(仅 owner)

say.text: 打进来的电话用接待员语气问候来电者并记下留言
say.note: 设置该号码的呼入指令

howto.what_en: Adds the Dial channel: a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. Messages in and out go through the dial CLI. The skill copies the adapter and tests, registers the channel, installs packages, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Dial channel — a real phone number for SMS, AI voice calls, etc. It copies the adapter, registers the channel, signs in to Dial, and pairs your phone.

say_en.text: Add the Dial channel and give me a number I can text
say_en.note: Installs the adapter, then walks you through Dial sign-in

say_en.text: Only my own phone may text this Dial line
say_en.note: Sets the line's unknown-sender policy to strict

say_en.text: Answer calls to this number as a receptionist and take a message
